from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "The Anatomy of a Neuron"
        lines = [
            "An artificial neuron receives multiple input signals.",
            "Each input is multiplied by its unique weight.",
            "The weighted inputs are summed with a bias value.",
            "An activation function decides the final output strength.",
            "This process determines if a signal passes forward."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # Colors
        NEURON_COLOR = "#FFFFFF"
        WEIGHT_COLOR = "#ADD8E6"  # Light Blue
        ACTIVATION_COLOR = "#FFFF00"  # Yellow
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = "#FFFF00"

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        neuron = Circle(radius=0.6, color=NEURON_COLOR)
        self.place_at_grid(neuron, 'C3')
        
        # Input arrows
        input_points = ['B1', 'C1', 'D1']
        inputs = VGroup()
        arrows = VGroup()
        for i, pt in enumerate(input_points):
            dot = Dot(color=WHITE)
            self.place_at_grid(dot, pt)
            label = MathTex(f"x_{i+1}", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
            label.next_to(dot, LEFT, buff=0.1)
            
            arrow = Arrow(dot.get_center(), neuron.get_left(), buff=0.1, color=WHITE, stroke_width=2)
            inputs.add(dot, label)
            arrows.add(arrow)

        self.play(Create(neuron), run_time=1)
        self.play(FadeIn(inputs), Create(arrows), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        weights = VGroup()
        weight_labels = ["w_1", "w_2", "w_3"]
        for i, arrow in enumerate(arrows):
            w_label = MathTex(weight_labels[i], font_size=20, color=WEIGHT_COLOR)
            w_label.move_to(arrow.get_center() + UP * 0.2)
            weights.add(w_label)
            
        self.play(Write(weights), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        sum_formula = MathTex(r"\sum w_i x_i + b", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(sum_formula, 'C3')
        
        self.play(Write(sum_formula), run_time=1)
        self.play(neuron.animate.set_stroke(width=6), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(neuron.animate.set_stroke(width=2), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        # ReLU graph area E4-F6
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-1, 2, 1],
            y_range=[-0.5, 2, 1],
            x_length=2,
            y_length=2,
            axis_config={"include_tip": False, "font_size": 18}
        ).set_color(WHITE)
        
        relu_graph = axes.plot(lambda x: max(0, x), x_range=[-1, 2], color=ACTIVATION_COLOR)
        relu_label = MathTex(r"f(z) = \max(0, z)", font_size=20, color=ACTIVATION_COLOR)
        
        graph_group = VGroup(axes, relu_graph, relu_label).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.2)
        self.place_in_area(graph_group, 'E4', 'F6', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(graph_group), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        
        output_arrow = Arrow(neuron.get_right(), self.grid['C5'], buff=0.1, color=ACTIVATION_COLOR)
        output_label = MathTex("y", font_size=24, color=ACTIVATION_COLOR)
        output_label.next_to(output_arrow, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(Create(output_arrow), Write(output_label), run_time=1)
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Cleanup highlight
        self.lecture[4].set_color(WHITE)
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section3Scene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # Background and Title
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=20, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4)
        self.lecture.scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # 6x6 Grid System for positioning on the right half of the screen
        self.grid_coords = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]

        # Grid logic: x from 1 to 5, y from 2 to -2
        for i, row_label in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col_label in enumerate(cols):
                x_pos = 1.0 + (j * 0.8)
                y_pos = 2.0 - (i * 0.8)
                self.grid_coords[f"{row_label}{col_label}"] = np.array([x_pos, y_pos, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos):
        mobject.move_to(self.grid_coords[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def construct(self):
        # Section Content
        title = "Neural Network Architecture"
        bullets = [
            "- Input Layer: Feature Vectors",
            "- Hidden Layers: Weighted Sums",
            "- Activation: Non-linearity",
            "- Output Layer: Predictions"
        ]

        self.setup_layout(title, bullets)

        # Visualization: Representing Neurons
        neurons = VGroup()
        
        # Draw a simple column of neurons using grid positions
        for row in ["B", "C", "D", "E"]:
            neuron = Circle(radius=0.25, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.5)
            self.place_at_grid(neuron, f"{row}2")
            neurons.add(neuron)

        # Second column
        for row in ["B", "C", "D", "E"]:
            neuron = Circle(radius=0.25, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.5)
            self.place_at_grid(neuron, f"{row}5")
            neurons.add(neuron)

        # Connections
        lines = VGroup()
        for i in range(4):
            for j in range(4):
                line = Line(
                    neurons[i].get_right(), 
                    neurons[j+4].get_left(), 
                    stroke_width=1, 
                    stroke_opacity=0.4,
                    color=GRAY
                )
                lines.add(line)

        # Animation sequence
        self.play(
            AnimationGroup(
                *[Create(n) for n in neurons],
                lag_ratio=0.1
            ),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.play(Create(lines), run_time=2)
        
        # Highlight a specific path
        highlight_line = Line(
            neurons[1].get_right(), 
            neurons[6].get_left(), 
            color=YELLOW, 
            stroke_width=4
        )
        self.play(Create(highlight_line))
        self.wait(2)
